subject: Recap: MAP draft and signature cadence — target close discussion
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@meridiantech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: MAP draft and signature cadence — target close discussion

Hi Alyssa — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick written recap + MAP draft attached so we have a single source of truth. Main points from our call: 

- Target business goal: shorten index search latency in customer-facing app (expect 35% avg improvement).
- Primary buyers: Alyssa (Data & Ops), Procurement (legal/terms), IT (SSO/compliance).
- Preferred deployment: Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput.

Attached: MAP-v0.9-meridian.xlsx (draft milestones). Please confirm: 
- Target contract signature date you mentioned on the call: 2026-12-15?
- Any hard procurement deadlines we should be aware of?

Proposed MAP milestones (high-level):
1) Tech validation: 11/30 — sandbox tests complete (owner: Meridian: Data Eng; Redwood: Solutions)
2) Security review: 12/01 — SOC2 + SSO checklist (owner: Meridian: IT; Redwood: Security)
3) Commercial review & PO: 12/04 — procurement issues PO (owner: Meridian: Procurement)
4) Signature & onboarding kickoff: 12/15 — legal sign-off (owner: Meridian + Redwood Legal)

Next steps: if those dates are optimistic for you, tell us which milestone slips and who we should loop in on your side. Also cc'ed Marissa and Ben so we can coordinate SOW & pricing cadence.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-v0.9-meridian.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)
From: Alyssa Park <alyssa@meridiantech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Recap: MAP draft and signature cadence — target close discussion

Thanks Jordan — useful summary. A few clarifications and constraints from our side: 

- The 12/15 signature is optimistic given end-of-year budgets. Our procurement team prefers signatures no later than 12/01 to guarantee processing before the holiday blackout. If we miss that, the earliest legal can realistically sign is ~01/10.
- Hard dependency: our IT team requires a one-week window for SSO integration test prep; we need the SSO docs and metadata by 11/27 to hit the 12/01 procurement cutover.
- Compliance ask: can you send SOC2 scope and data residency notes? Our internal audit will review.

On owners: please list Meridian’s procurement contact (I will loop them in). For the technical validation step we will own sandbox testing but need Redwood engineers to provide a small reference dataset and pre-built container (or dedicated sandbox).

I’m cc’ing Procurement alias below for visibility.
Procurement: procurement@meridiantech.com

Happy to tighten the milestones once I hear back on SSO and SOC2.

Best,
Alyssa Park
Director, Data & Operations
Meridian Tech
alyssa@meridiantech.com | +1 617-555-0143
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@meridiantech.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Recap: MAP draft and signature cadence — target close discussion

Alyssa — appreciate the constraints. A couple of pragmatic proposals from our side to reduce friction and improve chance of a 12/01 procurement completion: 

- Split-signature approach: execute an initial commercial agreement (term sheet + MSA summary) by 12/01, followed by detailed SOW and formal signature by 12/15. This gets you budget approved and lets procurement raise a PO.
- Redwood will provide: SOC2 summary + SSO integration guide (target: EOD 11/25) and a pre-configured sandbox image for sandbox testing (target: 11/27).
- Responsibility matrix suggestion (short):
  * Meridian Data Eng — sandbox run + internal validation (owner)
  * Meridian IT — SSO test & compliance verification
  * Redwood Solutions (Jordan) — provide sandbox + test plan
  * Redwood Security (Ben) — provide SOC2 artifacts + controls mapping

I attached an SOW outline that maps milestones to deliverables and billing triggers. If Maritime procurement needs a single invoice or PO flow, note that now and I’ll reflect in the draft.

Link to deal in HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/D-2026-1120-MER

—Ben
Ben Carter
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 212-555-0182

Attachments: SOW-outline.pdf (doc, 72KB)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@meridiantech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@meridiantech.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Recap: MAP draft and signature cadence — target close discussion

Thanks Ben, Alyssa — appreciate the practical path. Per Ben’s split-signature idea, I drafted a trimmed MAP version that supports an initial commercial commitment and PO by 12/01 (attached). Highlighted changes: 

- Commercial pre-commit (by 12/01): term sheet + initial PO covering reserved capacity deposit (owner: Meridian Procurement).
- Tech validation (sandbox): 11/27 — Redwood provides sandbox image + test kit (owner: Redwood Solutions).
- Security artifacts delivered: 11/25 (owner: Redwood Security).
- Full SOW & final signature: target 12/15 but flexible if procurement needs earlier.

Attachments: MAP-v1-meridian.xlsx (updated milestone owners + DocuSign placeholders).
DocuSign link (draft): https://docusign.example.com/meridian/map-2026 

Alyssa — who is the procurement lead? If you share their name + phone, I’ll add them to the DocuSign envelope and route the term sheet for PO approval. Also, if Meridian requires custom tax or legal clauses, let us know so Legal can prepare redlines in advance.

Proposed next steps (this week):
- Ben sends SOC2 summary and SSO guide by 11/25 (Ben)
- Jordan shares sandbox container and test plan by 11/27 (Jordan)
- Alyssa adds procurement lead and confirms whether split-signature is acceptable (Alyssa)

Thanks — I’ll stand by for procurement contact and will update the HubSpot record.

Jordan Blake
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Jordan/Ben — confirmed, split-signature sounds workable. I’ve added our procurement lead to this thread: 
- Samir Joshi <samir.joshi@meridiantech.com> (Head of Procurement, +1 617-555-0299)

I’ll route Ben’s SOC2 summary and your sandbox artifacts to IT this afternoon. If Redwood can deliver SSO metadata and the SOC2 summary by EOD 11/25, procurement will aim to issue an initial PO by 12/01. If any of those items slip, we’ll revert to the 12/15 full-signature plan.

One small note on billing: Meridian prefers quarterly invoicing and requires invoice line for reserved capacity deposit. Please indicate deposit amount in the term sheet or SOW.

Thanks — will follow up once procurement acknowledges receipt.

Best,
Alyssa
